method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Defamation Act 2005 (WA) (No. 44 of 2005), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_602.txt (legislation.wa.gov.au mrdoc 602, retrieved 2026-09-07); the compilation table lists no amendment, so the 2021 model reforms (s 10A serious harm, ss 12A-12B concerns notice before suing, s 29A public interest) are not in it; checked on legislation.wa.gov.au on 2026-10-21: WA has not amended the Act (one consolidated version, history table lists only the 2005 Act, no amending Act as passed), so the deposit is the current text and the 2021 reforms are not law in WA; with the Limitation Act 2005 (WA) ss 15, 40 as deposited at ../../../limitation-act-2005/registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_47979.txt (mrdoc 47979, retrieved 2026-09-07); no regulations or Gazette orders: the maximum damages amount at the time of award is an input

checks.command: l4 run da-cases-claims.l4; l4 run da-qa-cases.l4; l4 check da-qa.l4
checks.result: da-cases-claims.l4: 45 of 45 assertions satisfied; da-qa-cases.l4: 132 of 132 satisfied; 0 errors and 0 warnings in every file; l4 check da-qa.l4 succeeds
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: ss 7, 9 (corporations: excluded corporations; s 9(5) the individual's own claim), 10 (deceased persons), 14 (concerns notice; further particulars in 14 days; the 28 days for an offer), 15(1)(a)-(f) (content of an offer to make amends), 16(4)-(5) (renewed offer), 17(1) (acceptance bars suit once carried out), 18(1) (defence for a reasonable offer refused), 23 (leave), 25, 26, 31(1), (4)(a), (5), 33 (justification, contextual truth, honest opinion, triviality), 35 (non-economic loss cap $250 000 indexed to the nearest $500; aggravated damages), 37 (no exemplary damages); Limitation Act 2005 ss 15, 40 (one year; extension to 3 years). Out: s 11, ss 19-22, 27-30, 31(2)-(3), 32, 34, 36, 38-48, Schedule 4.
